records.subject: Labour, Employment, Wages and Productivity
records.groupTitle: Proportion Of Contributing Family Workers Among Employed Residents Aged 15 Years And Over By Sex
records.title: Proportion Of Contributing Family Workers Among Employed Residents Aged 15 Years And Over By Sex, Annual
records.footnote: Data refer to the proportion of employed residents (Singapore citizens and permanent residents) who assist in the operation of family business without receiving regular wages or salaries.  Data for 1995, 2000 and 2005 are not available as the Comprehensive Labour Force Survey was not conducted in these years due to the conduct of the Census and General Household Survey by the Singapore Department of Statistics.  Data are used for SDG 8.3.1 'Proportion of informal employment in total employment, by sector and sex'.  Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 8.3.1.
